3.name: Bloodthirst
3.notes:
When an enemy within 30 feet takes damage and becomes Bloodied (but is not killed outright), you may use a Reaction to teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of that enemy and then make one melee attack.

Usable a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum once). All uses are restored after a Long Rest.

3.name: Dread Allegiance
3.notes:
Choose one of the Dead Three: Bane, Bhaal, or Myrkul. You gain Resistance to a damage type and learn a cantrip based on your choice (Intelligence is your spellcasting ability). You may change this choice after each Long Rest.

Bane: Resistance to Psychic damage; learn Minor Illusion.
Bhaal: Resistance to Poison damage; learn Blade Ward.
Myrkul: Resistance to Necrotic damage; learn Chill Touch.

9.name: Strike Fear
9.notes:
You gain a new Cunning Strike option:

Terrify (Cost: 1d6). The target must make a Wisdom saving throw or be Frightened for 1 minute. While Frightened, you have Advantage on attack rolls against the target.

The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

13.name: Aura of Malevolence
13.notes:
When you use Bloodthirst and teleport, you may choose either the space you left or the space you arrive in. Each creature of your choice within 10 feet of that space takes damage equal to your Intelligence modifier. The damage type matches the Resistance granted by your current Dread Allegiance choice.

This damage ignores Resistance.

17.name: Dread Incarnate
17.notes:
Cutthroat. You regain one expended use of Bloodthirst when you finish a Short Rest.

Murderous Intent. When rolling Sneak Attack damage, you may treat any roll of 1 or 2 as a 3.
